instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: I check school budgets for the local government. I lay out device costs and papers about learning help on my desk. I mark them with sticky notes. Should money for putting phones away count as spending to help students do better at school? I start writing a note about the budget review, then stop. How can I explain the link between not using phones and learning? The budget cannot make money appear from nowhere. I worry that money for the bags could mean less help for students who need help with learning. At the same time, I still do not know if this cost is needed. I decide how the money is shared, so I cannot avoid explaining why.
